related.title: Falco：事件丟棄、輸出壅塞與偵測盲區
related.titleEn: Falco: event drops, output congestion and detection blind spots
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付基準、差分批次、按名稱及full tuple兩種視圖與缺批次注入測試，保留查詢版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver baseline, delta batches, name and full-tuple views, missing-batch fixtures and the exact query version.
related.difference: 建立來源事件、進入規則引擎、產生警示與成功輸出四層計數，分開記錄各層重設時點。
related.differenceEn: Create counters for source events, rule-engine arrivals, alerts and successful outputs, tracking resets independently.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 新狀態=(舊狀態−removed)∪added；只有確認基準與差分未缺漏時才能重建完整狀態。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 初始有8個套件tuple；一次更新移除2個舊版本tuple並新增其2個新版本，加裝1個新套件。 結果有8−2+2+1=9個套件tuple；不能把3筆added都稱為新安裝。
擷取丟棄率與警示輸出丟棄率使用不同分母，不能相加為總偵測失敗率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成來源100000事件，其中3000未進入規則引擎；引擎產生200警示，其中10未完成輸出。 擷取丟棄率3%；警示輸出丟棄率5%。本課數值檢查聚焦固定來源分母的擷取比例。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: New state is (old−removed) union added; complete reconstruction requires an established baseline and no missing deltas. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The baseline contains eight package tuples; an update removes two old versions, adds two replacements and installs one new package. The result has nine tuples; the three added rows do not represent three newly installed packages.

Capture-drop and alert-output-drop rates use different denominators and cannot be added into a detector failure rate. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The fixture has 100000 source events, 3000 missing before rule evaluation, 200 generated alerts and ten output failures. Capture drop rate is 3% and alert-output drop rate 5%; numerical checks focus on the fixed source denominator.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Volatility 3：符號有效性門檻與跨映像分析覆蓋
related.titleEn: Volatility 3: symbol-validity gates and cross-image analysis coverage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付基準、差分批次、按名稱及full tuple兩種視圖與缺批次注入測試，保留查詢版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver baseline, delta batches, name and full-tuple views, missing-batch fixtures and the exact query version.
related.difference: 為每個合成映像保存雜湊、OS建置、符號包識別、相容性依據與外掛退出狀態；只有需求滿足且完成的項目可進入後續分析。
related.differenceEn: For each synthetic image, record hash, OS build, symbol-package identity, compatibility evidence and plugin exit status. Only items with satisfied requirements and completed execution enter subsequent analytical comparisons.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 新狀態=(舊狀態−removed)∪added；只有確認基準與差分未缺漏時才能重建完整狀態。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 初始有8個套件tuple；一次更新移除2個舊版本tuple並新增其2個新版本，加裝1個新套件。 結果有8−2+2+1=9個套件tuple；不能把3筆added都稱為新安裝。

Volatility 3依賴適當符號與記憶體層；符號存在不代表與映像相容，需求失敗屬未知結果，不應建立空的成功程序清單。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 10份合成映像中8份符號相容，其中7份外掛成功、1份讀取失敗；另外2份符號不符。所有建置與檔名皆為教學代號。 符號相容率8/10=80%，可分析覆蓋7/10=70%；相容且失敗的那份不能算成功，兩種比率不可互換。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: New state is (old−removed) union added; complete reconstruction requires an established baseline and no missing deltas. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The baseline contains eight package tuples; an update removes two old versions, adds two replacements and installs one new package. The result has nine tuples; the three added rows do not represent three newly installed packages.

Volatility 3 depends on suitable symbols and memory layers. A symbol file being present does not establish image compatibility; unmet requirements produce an unknown result rather than a successful empty process inventory. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Of ten synthetic images, eight have compatible symbols: seven plugins complete and one encounters a read failure. Two other images have incompatible symbols. Builds and filenames are original teaching identifiers. Symbol compatibility is 8/10=80%, but analyzable coverage is 7/10=70%. The compatible image with failed execution is not successful, and these two proportions cannot substitute for one another.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
